sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti-Tarnish Triple Band Adjustable Wave Ring
sourceNotes.rawContent:
- Elevate your style with this chic gold-plated adjustable ring featuring a modern triple band wave design. Crafted for comfort and durability, this elegant piece is perfect for daily wear, parties, and gifting – a must-have in every jewelry collection.
- Highlights / Specifications:
- Material: High-quality stainless steel / brass
- Plating: Premium gold plating for long-lasting shine
- Stone Type: Plain, no stone – minimalist elegance
- Design: Triple band wave design for a modern look
- Size/ Fit: Adjustable – fits most finger sizes comfortably
- Best For: Daily wear, casual outings, parties & gifting
